name: Rosenheim (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Rosenheim (a white rose on red).
history: Municipal flag of Rosenheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Rosenheim arms — white rose on red
